text: Pogačar arrives at cycling's most storied summit with a luxury most leaders never get—a seven-minute cushion—but UAE's virus-ravaged roster may force him to defend that gap himself. Evenepoel has the legs and the restraint to pick his moment on five category climbs that will shred any remaining team support, and with Pogačar's domestiques falling away, even a measured attack could splinter the yellow jersey's advantage. The five-climb gauntlet favors a rider who can float through the early slopes and strike late, where team depth becomes irrelevant and raw climbing power decides the day. Watch whether Pogačar bleeds time before Alpe d'Huez even begins—or whether Evenepoel finally finds the opening his form has been promising.
